title: Varied Temples
description: Makes desert temples more random and interesting.
body: # Description Adds 12+ types of desert temples with custom traps that make each adventure unique, preventing you from memorizing the trap as easily. More may be added in the future. Some temples are even themed around biomes! Current: - Vanilla - Dripstone - Mining - Poison - Fake - Desert - Nether - Plains - Trial Chambers - Sculk - Water - Dropper - End - Ice # Versions Supports Java Edition 1.21 - 26.2 # Compatibility Incompatible with anything with the same filenames. Does not contain any functions or laggy stuff. ![Water Temple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23496f47027ea17f5e9ef169cb972f23cf5d1b13.png) ![Sculk Temple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d6301ac8c6a4ce1be837687bae3b023ac34ad212.png) ![Trial Chambers Temple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e799ab457996b6441b2fc6ad75a999331e8a1ff.png) ![End Temple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3effe6d35840d1c187f1e762953a554cdc4c47c1.png)
